_comment: The WBW trail, baked at build time so the app never spends a routing quota or
needs a network to draw it. Regenerate from newroute.gpx in the project root;
nothing in the code hard-codes the point count.
Source: newroute.gpx - the organisers' Google Maps walking route exported via
GoogleMapsToGPX, https://maps.app.goo.gl/in2X5zXj9MQGVYHM7 - so this is Google's
own path, not a re-route. It replaces the earlier route.gpx, which ran a
different loop; this one starts at Wat Phrachao Lan Thong and finishes north-east
at 20.05675,99.90870 rather than returning to the start.
polyline is Google's encoded-polyline format at precision 5, lossless here because
the GPX carries exactly 5 decimal places. 504 points.
distanceMetres is summed from the track; the GPX carries no timings, so there is
deliberately no duration field rather than an invented one.
